auto_login_remember: Save credentials and sign in at startup
auto_login_settings_note: Manage the email and password stored in the OS keyring.
auto_login_note: Sign in to the saved account when the app starts. The saved session is tried first; email and password are used only when authentication is unavailable. Credentials are stored in the OS keyring. A verification code will be shown if phone approval is required.
auto_login_load_failed: Saved credentials could not be retrieved. Unlock the keyring or sign in manually.
auto_login_saved: Credentials saved in the OS keyring. Automatic sign-in will start on the next launch.
auto_login_save_failed: The keyring operation failed. Automatic sign-in is disabled. Check secret-tool and the OS keyring.
auto_login_enabled: Startup sign-in is enabled. Enter new credentials to change them.
auto_login_forgotten: Automatic sign-in disabled and saved credentials deleted.
video_play_failed: Could not play this video. Open it in another app or download it to check the file.
unsend_body: This removes the message from both sides of the chat. A notice will appear. Time limits and other LINE conditions apply.
unsend_failed: Could not unsend the message. Check LINE conditions and your connection.
reaction_pack_failed: Could not load this emoji set.
reaction_packs_failed: Could not load your LINE emoji sets.
reaction_no_recent_emoji: LINE emoji you see in chats will appear here.
reaction_failed: Could not send the reaction. Check your connection and try again.
reaction_expired: This message is too old to react to.
reaction_emoji_unavailable: LINE did not accept this emoji as a reaction. You may need to own the emoji set.
copy_message_select_hint: Select text to copy, or copy the whole message. Ctrl+C copies your selection.
features_font_desc: Type any installed system font name, then press Apply.
notifications_subtitle: Alert when a message arrives outside the focused chat
read_receipts_pause_subtitle: While on, this app will not send read receipts. Other devices can still mark messages as read.
read_receipts_pause_save_failed: Could not change the switch because settings could not be saved.
auto_mark_read_subtitle: Tell LINE you read the chat when you open it
animations_subtitle: Page fades, message enter, and soft hover motion
settings_desktop_desc: System tray and window close behavior
tray_enabled_subtitle: Keep line-gtk running from the tray when the window is hidden
settings_discord_desc: Rich Presence while Discord desktop is running. Default Application ID is built in; override only if you use your own Discord app.
discord_rpc_subtitle: Show LINE GTK on your Discord profile
discord_rpc_show_chat_subtitle: Include the open conversation name (visible to friends)
discord_rpc_show_avatar_subtitle: Small Discord image uses your LINE avatar
discord_rpc_show_name_subtitle: Include your LINE name in presence (friends can see it)
close_to_tray_subtitle: Off: close button quits the app. On: hide to tray instead
autostart_subtitle: Start line-gtk automatically when you log in to your desktop
autostart_hidden_subtitle: Autostart without opening the window. Needs the system tray
autostart_portal_reason: Start line-gtk when you log in
tray_chat_missing: Chat not found in the list yet
cache_retention_desc: How long chats/messages stay warm. Stickers, photos, and avatars stay on disk until you clear them.
message_cache_limit_desc: How many messages of each chat are stored on this computer. Stored messages are encrypted with a key in your system keyring. When a chat nears the limit you will be warned.
message_cache_limit_subtitle: Older messages beyond the limit are dropped from the cache
cache_limit_body: {chat} has {count} of {limit} cached messages. When the limit is reached the oldest messages are dropped from this computer (they stay on LINE's servers only as long as LINE keeps them).
clear_cache_desc: Speeds up reopen; clearing forces re-download.
add_friend_desc: LINE ID / userid (if linejs can resolve it)
logout_subtitle: Remove saved token and return to QR login
logged_out_hint: Logged out. Scan QR to sign in again.
about_desc: line-gtk is an unofficial native LINE client for Linux. It is not affiliated with LY Corporation or LINE.
about_credits_desc: Maintained by MidnightTale. Built with Rust, GTK4, Libadwaita, and GLib. Protocol engine: Deno with @evex/linejs (Thrift, E2EE, ForSecure QR). Also uses Tokio, Serde, reqwest, image/png, qrcode, Chrono, and the gtk-rs / libadwaita-rs bindings. Thank you to every upstream maintainer.
about_license_desc: line-gtk is free software under the GNU General Public License version 3 (GPL-3.0). You may redistribute and modify it under that license. LINE and related marks belong to LY Corporation.
message_decryption_failed: Cannot decrypt this message. Authenticate again on your phone to retrieve encryption keys.
e2ee_repair_hint: Authenticate again on your phone to decrypt messages. Saved keys are preserved.
e2ee_repair_failed: Could not start encryption key recovery.
login_pin_caption: Enter this PIN on your phone
login_note: Unofficial. LINE ToS risk applies. Prefer a secondary session.
login_email_hint: Log in with the email address and password registered to LINE.
login_password_note: Credentials are stored in the OS keyring only when saving is enabled. You may need to enter a verification code on your phone.
login_email_missing: Enter your email address and password.
login_email_failed: Could not log in. Check your credentials and login permission on your phone, then try again.
login_email_timeout: Verification timed out. Please log in again.
login_keys_missing: Could not retrieve encryption keys from your phone. Confirm the login on your phone and try again.
login_in_progress: A login is already in progress.
login_email_calls_note: Log in with a QR code to use voice calls.
login_pin_waiting: Enter this PIN in the LINE app
settings_downloads_desc: Where saved photos, videos, voice, and files go
download_ask_every_time_subtitle: Always pick a location. Off saves into the folders below
media_text_truncated: Showing first part of a large file…
media_unsupported_preview: No in-app preview for this file. Download or open externally.
attach_file: Attach photo, video, audio, or file
attachment_draft_hint: Attachments are drafts. Press Send when ready.
sticker_import_label: Download a sticker pack as images
sticker_import_placeholder: LINE STORE pack link or ID
sticker_image_click_hint: Click to send with saved settings. Right-click to edit size and background.
sticker_image_edit_hint: Removes flat edge backgrounds. Original files are kept. Smaller sizes add transparent margins; LINE controls the final display size.
sticker_image_bg_unchanged: No flat background removed: already transparent or no uniform edge color.
sticker_import_invalid: Enter a valid LINE STORE sticker pack link or numeric ID.
sticker_import_unavailable: Could not download this pack. Check the link and try again.
voice_call_unavailable: Voice call unavailable for this chat
call_experimental_toast: Voice calls are experimental. Unlock them in Settings → Experimental.
settings_experimental_desc: Unstable features. Changing this restarts the app and requires QR login again.
experimental_calls_subtitle: Show the call button and call settings. Requires restart and re-login.
exp_calls_warn_body: Voice calls are unsupported, unstable, and not an official release. They may crash the app or break your session. Enabling will restart line-gtk and make you scan QR to log in again. Do not report issues related to this feature.
exp_calls_disable_body: Disabling will restart line-gtk and make you scan QR to log in again. The call button will be hidden.
exp_calls_relogin_toast: Restarting. Scan QR to log in again.
exp_calls_relogin_hint: Experimental calls setting changed. Scan QR to log in again.
settings_calls_desc: Only available after unlocking experimental voice calls
notification_sound_subtitle: Play the system notification sound with alerts
mute_unsupported_chat: Notifications can be changed for 1:1 and group chats
voice_call_note: Voice calls need an Android LINE session. Re-scan QR after update
relogin_android_required: Re-scan QR to enable voice calls (Android session, per linejs docs)
line_network_unavailable: Cannot reach LINE. Check your connection, then retry. Your session is saved.
line_server_unavailable: LINE is temporarily unavailable or rate limiting requests. Wait, then retry. Your session is saved.
line_protocol_failed: LINE rejected the connection or its protocol changed. Retry or update LINE GTK. Your session is saved.
protocol_recovery_failed: Protocol engine could not be restarted
diagnostics_subtitle: Runtime, dependencies, codecs, paths, and logs
album_empty_page: No albums on these pages. You can keep loading.
album_video_unsupported: Video viewing is not supported yet
album_save_failed: Could not save the photo. Check the destination and free space.
album_not_logged_in: Please wait until login is complete
album_photo_expired: Photo details expired. Refresh the album.
album_image_unsupported: This image format cannot be displayed
album_image_too_large: This image is too large to display (50 MB limit)
hidden_chats_subtitle: Restore hidden chats to the chat list
hidden_chats_description: Hidden from this PC’s chat list. History is kept and new messages stay hidden. Notification settings are unchanged.
hidden_chat_save_failed: Could not save settings. No changes were applied.
hidden_chat_open_hint: Restore this chat in Settings → Features → Hidden chats
chat_read_pause_enable: Do not mark this friend’s messages as read
chat_read_pause_disable: Resume read receipts for this friend
chat_read_pause_active: Read receipts paused for this friend
chat_read_pause_enabled: Read receipts paused for this friend
chat_read_pause_disabled: Read receipts will resume on your next normal interaction
chat_event_link_join_allowed: Joining by invitation link is now allowed
chat_event_link_join_disabled: Joining by invitation link is now disabled
mark_read_once_tooltip: Mark current messages as read once, keeping read receipts paused for future messages.
mark_read_once_done: Marked read up to this point. Pause settings are unchanged.
mark_read_once_failed: Could not mark messages as read. Unread status has been kept.
contact_block_body: Block this user on LINE to stop direct messages and calls. Chat history is kept and you can unblock later. Group messages are unaffected.
contact_block_failed: Could not update block status. Check your connection and try again.
contact_blocked_send: Unblock this user before sending a message.
blocked_contacts_subtitle: View and manage your LINE block list
blocked_contacts_description: Your LINE account block list. You can unblock users even without an existing chat.
mention_load_failed: Could not load members. Click to retry.
reply_original_unavailable: The original message could not be found.
shared_media_failed: Could not load shared media. Cached items are kept. Try Refresh.
shared_media_partial: Cached: {cached} · Pending: {pending} · Failed: {failed}. Discovery paused; refresh to retry.
shared_media_caching: Caching shared media… {cached} cached · {pending} pending · {failed} unavailable
shared_media_empty: No shared items in this tab.
shared_media_original_failed: The original could not be opened. It may be unavailable; click again to retry.
outbox_not_sent: Not sent. Your text is back in the message box.
message_search_scope: Searches messages saved on this device in this conversation. Older messages may not be saved.
message_search_empty: No matches in saved messages. Try a different word or load older history.
message_search_failed: Could not search messages. Edit your query to try again.
sticker_library_adopt_hint: Add the previous shared image library to this account.
sticker_library_remove_hint: Remove from this library? Source files and sent messages are kept.
sticker_library_copies: Select PNG or APNG files to keep in the library. The app saves copies; source files stay unchanged. Up to 10 MiB and 2048 × 2048 pixels each; 100 files per import. Animated images are sent as GIFs.
sticker_import_cancelled: Import cancelled. Saved images are kept.
sticker_import_busy: An import with this ID is already running.
sticker_library_invalid: Could not read the image library. Existing files have been kept.
sticker_library_not_logged_in: Sign in before using your image library.
sticker_library_session_changed: The account or session changed. Open the library again.
sticker_pack_missing: This pack is no longer in the library.
sticker_pack_name_invalid: Enter a pack name of 1–100 characters.
sticker_png_invalid: This is not a valid static PNG.
sticker_png_animated: Animated PNGs are not supported by this importer.
sticker_png_changed: The source file changed. Select it again.
sticker_png_unreadable: Could not read this PNG. Check the file and try again.
sticker_library_owned_unavailable: Could not refresh owned LINE packs. Saved image packs are available.
sticker_optimize_hint: Reduce file size with optional resizing. Preview the result before saving; originals are kept. Saved settings apply to later sends.
sticker_optimize_gif_hint: Animation is sent as GIF. GIF supports up to 256 colors and fully transparent or opaque pixels; smooth translucent edges may change. Conversion may increase file size.
sticker_optimize_small_gif_hint: Preview at 128 px, 10 fps, and 32 colors to reduce download size.
sticker_optimize_failed: Could not convert this image. Try a smaller size or fewer colors.
sticker_optimize_too_large: The converted image exceeds 10 MiB. Reduce its size, frame rate, or colors.
sticker_optimize_timeout: Image conversion took too long. Try a smaller size.
sticker_ffmpeg_missing: Install ffmpeg to convert or optimize images.
sticker_animation_limits: Animation is too large or long: maximum 240 frames, 30 seconds, and 32 million decoded pixels.
poll_session_changed: The login session changed. Reopen this dialog.
poll_title_long: The question is too long (70 characters max).
poll_choice_long: An option is too long (60 characters max).
poll_close_past: The closing time must be in the future.
